how: We read the website of every San Antonio wedding DJ listed on Lazo (40 listings, 29 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a nationwide one-stop entertainment chain, a multi-city DJ company's San Antonio page, a live band and party rental outfit based near Austin, duplicate listings of the same company, and a DJ splitting time between San Antonio and Tennessee. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Many Hill Country receptions are outdoors. Do you bring your own power and weather cover, and is the ceremony sound a separate setup?
Who exactly is my DJ, and can I talk to that person before signing?
What is in the base package, and what do uplighting, a photo booth and extra hours add?

picks.name: Alusstra Events Lighting in San Antonio
picks.blurb: Alusstra Events has been in sound, lighting and video technology for 26 years, with event DJs, photo booths, uplighting, equipment rentals and corporate AV from the same San Antonio company. The site prints a sample package built on a five-hour DJ with dance lighting and a two-speaker system.

picks.name: Power Sounds DJ Service
picks.blurb: Power Sounds is built around owner and founder David DePaz, with over 30 years of experience, and a roster of DJs introduced on the site. Ceremony-to-reception coverage for weddings in San Antonio, Austin, Boerne and New Braunfels, with a detailed, production-oriented approach.

picks.name: Cutting Edge Entertainment
picks.blurb: Cutting Edge Entertainment goes back to Houston in 1976, when David Cooper started playing private and club shows in the disco era; he brought the company to San Antonio in 1987. The site runs a blog on first dance songs and reception trends alongside wedding, corporate and school DJ services.

picks.name: DJ Lakha | Indian Wedding Luxury DJ | Austin | San Antonio | Dallas | Houston
picks.blurb: Lakha Singh, DJ Lakha, is Texas's luxury South Asian and multicultural wedding DJ, with twelve years of dancefloors from Hill Country venues to Mexico beaches and New York. Bollywood, Bhangra and fusion for everything from intimate Sangeets to full Indian weddings, serving San Antonio, Austin, Dallas and Houston.

picks.name: Platinum DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: Brandon and Jessica started Platinum DJ Entertainment in 2007 as a veteran- and family-owned business in San Antonio. They book only one event per day on a quality-over-quantity model, with a personalized, high-end level of service and a customer service guarantee.

picks.name: DJFORHIRE
picks.blurb: John of DJforHire works directly with each couple to build the reception timeline before the day, an insured wedding DJ covering San Antonio, Austin, Bexar County and the Hill Country. The site lists Knot and WeddingWire awards, LGBT weddings and a page on how he handles the end of the night.

picks.name: Gobo Entertainment Mobile DJ
picks.blurb: Gobo Entertainment fields wedding DJs, photo booths with props and prints, and live musicians for the ceremony, and says it runs hundreds of events a year in San Antonio. The site shows a real wedding and walks through how it works before you fill out the form.

picks.name: Four 40 Entertainment
picks.blurb: Four 40 Entertainment is a family-owned San Antonio company founded in 2012, and every package comes with an on-site tech, a DJ and an MC as standard. Bilingual, based in Leon Valley, and working weddings, quinceaneras and private events.

picks.name: Hesson Entertainment
picks.blurb: Hesson Entertainment has been entertaining for over 20 years with wedding DJ services, photo booths and uplighting, and offers to match or beat a competitor who comes in lower. Based in Bulverde, serving San Antonio and Austin as well as Washington, DC, with an online planning portal for booked clients.

picks.name: American DJs
picks.blurb: American DJs in Boerne collaborates with each couple on a playlist that reflects their taste, then adds uplighting matched to the venue and photo booths with custom backdrops and instant prints. The site quotes couples on Mark, one of its DJs.

picks.name: DJZ Event Group
picks.blurb: DJZ Event Group threw out the cookie cutter: bilingual DJs and MCs, LED robots, indoor sparklers and photo booths, each event tailored individually. A San Antonio company that also does a heavy quinceanera business, so ask for a wedding-specific sample.

picks.name: SoundSnap Entertainment
picks.blurb: SoundSnap Entertainment covers DJ, photo booth, PA and lighting in San Antonio and lays out a five-step process that starts with a phone consultation. Wedding DJ services run from the ceremony to the last dance, with photo booths offering custom templates and shareable prints.
